map.对本品任何成分过敏或正使用其他含对乙酰氨基酚药品时不要使用；有肝病、使用华法林、: Do not use if allergic to any ingredient or taking another acetaminophen product. Ask a clinician first about liver disease, warfarin, three or more alcoholic drinks daily, pregnancy, breastfeeding or arthritis pain in anyone under 18. Stop and seek immediate medical care for rash, blisters or other skin reactions. Seek immediate medical care after an overdose, even without symptoms.
